verdict.rationale: Cekura ingests production calls as CallLogs and runs metric evaluation on them (LLM-judge, Python metrics, rubrics). Its marketing claims it flags production issues and reproduces them in simulation, which roughly approximates turning traces into test cases. Offline runs are supported through evaluator scenarios, results comparison and A/B testing. However, no doc describes explicitly curating a dataset or test suite from selected production traces, and a community user asked whether linking simulations back to production sessions is still manual. missing for 10: documented workflow to select production calls into a curated dataset/test set, re-running offline evals against that curated set, independent hands-on corroboration.
